t1.lua

------------------------------------------------------------
-- This is an example implementation of the T1 experiment --
------------------------------------------------------------

-------------------------------------------------
-- Start by declaring the required api modules --
-------------------------------------------------
local api = require("api")
local standard = api.helpers.standard
local savehelper = api.operations.callbacks.savehelper
local logger = api.operations.logger
local dataTableUtils = api.operations.datatable.utils
local designerui = api.ui.designer
local common = api.operations.common

---------------------------------------
-- Then define a GUI for this script --
---------------------------------------
local tauStartSeconds = standard.millisecondsToSeconds(designerui.number("Tau Start: (ms)", 2, 1000, 0.1, 30000))
local tauEndSeconds = standard.millisecondsToSeconds(designerui.number("Tau Stop: (ms)", 2, 2500, 0.1, 30000))
local numSteps = designerui.number("Number of Points", 0, 16, 2, 8192)
local pointDist = designerui.binaryChoice("Point Distribution", "Logarithmic", "Linear", false)
local dummyScans = core:dummyScans()
-------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Create variables where experiment data will be stored,        --
-- and register them to be saved if the save button is pressed --
-------------------------------------------------------------------
local results = newResults2D("T1 Results")
savehelper.saveDataOnSaveButton(nil, "T1 Data", results)

local dataTable = newDataTable("T1 Summary", { xUnits = "ms" })
local integrals = core:copyIntegrals()
dataTableUtils.addIntegralEntries{dataTable=dataTable, integrals=integrals, withSum=true, fitFunction = "Exponential"}
dataTable:addEntry({ name = "FD Max",
                     label = "FD Max",
                     fitFunction = "Exponential" })
dataTable:addEntry({ name = "TD Max",
                     label = "TD Max",
                     fitFunction = "Exponential" })
savehelper.saveDataOnSaveButton(nil, "Summary", dataTable)

---------------------------------------------------------
-- Create displays and pages where data will be viewed --
---------------------------------------------------------
local page = DisplayPage { name = "T1 Summary" }
local display = DisplayDataTable(page,
        { name = "T1 Summary Display",
          datasetName = "T1 Summary",
          nextEntryButton = 'True',
          legend = 'upper left',
          cursorFormat = 'x: %0.1f ms\ny: %0.2f',
          xAxisTickLabelFormat = '%.1f ms' })
-- set the display parameters (for saving/loading)
dataTable:setDisplayParameters(display)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Make helper functions to create a pulse sequence, calculate tau, and callback functionality for  --
-- the T1 experiment and set some values in the core                                                --
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Wait for the length of an interscan delay before the first acquisition
setPreScanDelay(core:channelConfigSignal():interscanTime())

-- This is a helper function to calculate the tau for T1 pulse sequence. It must have acquisition for the argument.
local function calulateTau(acquisition)
    local tau = nil
    if pointDist == "Linear" then
        tau = acquisition * (tauEndSeconds - tauStartSeconds) / (numSteps - 1) + tauStartSeconds
    elseif pointDist == "Logarithmic" then
        tau = tauStartSeconds * math.pow( tauEndSeconds / tauStartSeconds, acquisition / (numSteps - 1) )
    else
        logger.err("Unknown point distribution method")
    end
    return tau
end

-- This is a helper function to create a T1 pulse sequence given tau. It must have acquisition for the argument.
local function createPulseSequence(acquisition)
    local p = PulseSequence(core:channelConfigSignal())
    p:add(newPulseSingle(core:channelConfigSignal()))
    p:add(newPulseSingle(core:channelConfigSignal()))
    p:setPulseTime(0, core:channelConfigSignal():get90PulseSeconds())
    p:setPulseTime(1, core:channelConfigSignal():get90PulseSeconds() * 2)
    p:setInterPulseTime(0, calulateTau(acquisition))
    core:usePulseSequence(p)
    return p
end

-- runMulti1DScans() will call this function after results gets updated every acquisition. Functionality such as
-- adding to the datatable, updating progress messages, or updating the display should be added here.
local function newResultAddedCallback()
    -- "acquisition" is zero based.
    local acquisition = results:numDataRows() - 1
    local tau = calulateTau(acquisition)
    local dataSet = results:dataSet(acquisition)

    -- Update progress before doing an acquisition
    setProgress(100 * acquisition / numSteps)
    setProgressMessage("T1: Running tau #" .. tostring(acquisition+1) .. " of " .. tostring(numSteps))
    setStatusMessage("T1: Running tau #" .. tostring(acquisition+1) .. " of " .. tostring(numSteps) .. ": " .. tostring(standard.secondsToMicroseconds(tau)) .. "us")

    local fdPeakIndex, fdPeak = core:dataSetSignal():fdMagPeak()
    local tdPeak = core:dataSetSignal():tdMagPeak()
    local tdPoint = core:dataSetSignal():td():at(0):real()

    -- Change the peak to a negative value if the first td point is negative
    if tdPoint < 0 then
        fdPeak = -fdPeak
        tdPeak = -tdPeak
    end

    -- Store the integrals and peaks
    local row = dataTableUtils.manualIntegralRow{integrals=integrals, withSum=true}
    table.insert(row, fdPeak)
    table.insert(row, tdPeak)
    dataTable:append(standard.secondsToMilliseconds(tau), row)

    if acquisition >= 1 then
        dataTable:fitAll()
        updateDisplay(dataTable)
    end
end

-- Run the main acquisitions based on the above functions
common.runMulti1DScans{
    setupMethod=createPulseSequence,
    yMethod=calulateTau,
    results=results,
    numPoints=numSteps,
    dummyScans=dummyScans,
    autoScaleCurrentResult=true,
    newResultAddedCallback=newResultAddedCallback
}

-- Update the display one last time
updateDisplay(dataTable)
-- Set the progress to 100%
setProgress(100)
setProgressMessage("Complete")
